challenged_claim: A universal bound sup_b ||p_(Q3 | Qrest=b)||_infinity <= C follows from the bare QFORM hypotheses and can serve as a full-proof gate.
counterexample_scope: Four iid Uniform[0,1] original coordinates; O is the 4x4 Hadamard orthogonal transform; A=O^T diag(1,1,1,eta)O with 0<eta<1, e.g. eta=1/128. The matrix is non-diagonal and has spectrum {1,1,1,eta}.
exact_failure: For Y4=y in (3/2,2), h=4-2y and Q3=h^2 T with T supported on [0,3/4]. Hence ||p_(Q3|Y4=y)||_infinity >=4/(3h^2). Since Qrest=eta Y4^2 is one-to-one there, ess sup_b ||p_(Q3|Qrest=b)||_infinity=infinity.
not_refuted: The full quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture. The same example is compatible with bounded output density.
replacement_interface: Use the unnormalized mixed norm integral ||p_(Q3,Qrest)(.,b)||_infinity db = integral p_(Qrest)(b)||p_(Q3|Qrest=b)||_infinity db. In the vertex regime the slice mass is h^3/6 and cancels the h^-2 conditional blow-up.
